installation.when: Main only, after the current Editor/build has exited. Refuses while this project's Temp/UnityLockfile exists.

collectionPolicy: Reads etos --json task --task ID and budget --task ID only for result.json's owned IDs, preserves redacted raw outputs and exit codes. Does not discover node files, inspect credentials, call providers, change the driver verdict or infer execution from prose.

environment.GAMECORE_P42H_OUT: Required by every executeMethod; launcher sets it to --out.
environment.GAMECORE_ETOS_PROJECT_ID: Launcher derives SHA-256 of productGUID lowercased + newline + exact root project path, using existing P42g convention.

launchPolicy: unity-batch.sh host allocator, established graphical adapter, --attempts 1, 900-second process deadline, ten-minute in-driver deadline. Never add -quit. The driver closes itself. Existing credential-path convention is reused, not inspected or printed. Main alone owns worker-budget reservations, ledger checks and all launches.

Root Hollowmere fixture, Bram NPC definition/graph and Village authored entity 2825db71-11a1-4155-b1db-9e7734111d9e, normal Boot world and menu/newgame path.
Unity 6000.0.75f1, display :1, pre-existing Hollowmere.P2_1.Evidence capture assembly and all referenced product assemblies.

No image/TTS/voice/describe/3D generation is requested; global media ledger must still be checked by Main.
The query row needs the same task's independent worker tool-call trace in addition to the retained authenticated worker result. A textual command claim never establishes execution.

collect: same task's raw worker tool-call trace
query.completion: Review the independent tool-call receipt against exact worker-query-receipt.json; do not edit original result.json to conceal its provenance prerequisite. Record the row decision separately.

assertions: Worker is explicitly asked to sleep 90 seconds before its read-only narrative review; no fake gateway pause or canned task state.
Authenticated request and tray both report running, exactly one identical task ID.
NavigationSubmitEvent delivered to actual enabled Cancel Button on an attached production task-tray row; no direct Cancel method shortcut.
Companion state and ETOS status become cancelled, one original task remains, one tray row remains, authoritative hasCandidate is false, no local candidate, three-second stable observation.
One real running worker task, deliberate bounded worker sleep, same request is never resubmitted.
Installed harness-only CompilePulse.cs bytes actually changed, AssetDatabase import plus RequestScriptCompilation executed, successful P42h.Tasks assembly compilation observed.
beforeAssemblyReload and DidReloadScripts in the same process, freshly loaded constant equals unique changed-source token, ETOS session Starts increases.
Same task still running after reload, same request and created row identity, exactly one attached tray row.

Production resumed event cursor sequence after pre-reload acknowledged cursor exactly equals a separate authenticated replay stream, without gaps/duplicates and with exactly one terminal cancellation event.
After the same-running-row observation, attached Cancel button is used to bound task lifetime; one cancelled task, no candidate.
reload.cleanup: Launcher restores only its installed CompilePulse.cs from TOOLS after process exit. A direct executeMethod invocation must perform this same owned-file restoration after the Editor exits, never while an Editor/build is running.

assertions: Authenticated app-origin StageAppCandidateAsync exists and signs the exact payload; the production stage service selects it for app-owned candidate provenance.
Current typed client and server router contain no running-stage cancellation method or route. Discard is explicitly not cancellation.
Only a bodyless authenticated GET to /v1/stage/{ownedJobOrProbeIdentity}/cancel is made; it does not submit, cancel, discard or kill anything.
No expensive stage is opened solely to demonstrate the absent endpoint. No slot release or region-load cancellation success is claimed.
stage-probe.blockingProductContract: Authenticated app/project-owned running-job cancel endpoint, durable cancellation state/receipt, child/slot teardown and observable slot reusability.

exitCodes.2: BLOCKED; consult result.json, not generic wrapper usage classification

missingResult: No result.json is never PASS. Preserve logs and classify NotRun/FAIL accurately. Do not repeat a text request automatically.
unexecutedBySlice: Per explicit assignment: no build, lint, test, formatter, Unity launch, ETOS command, provider request or service operation was run. Main owns serial proof.
